sloka: अन्योन्यं रजसा तेन कौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना ।संवृतानि च भूतानि ददृशुर्न रणाजिरे ।। ६.५५.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: anyonyaṁ rajasā tena kauśeyoddhūtapāṇḍunā ।saṁvṛtāni ca bhūtāni dadṛśurna raṇājire ।। 6.55.19 ।।।।

translations.english: The combatants could not see one another in the battlefield, and it seemed as though white silk piece was shaken by the wind by the appearance of the surrounding dust.
